headline: Draft approved to abolish RAB and form SRB
summary: The government has given final approval to a draft law to replace the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) with the Special Security Bureau (SRB).
details: The government has granted final approval to a draft law that will lead to the abolition of the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) and the creation of the Special Security Bureau (SRB).
This major structural change in the country's security apparatus aims to replace the elite force with a new entity.
The decision comes after a period of review and deliberation regarding the role and legal framework of the security forces.
The SRB will take over the responsibilities previously held by RAB, though specific operational details of the new bureau are still being finalized.
caption:
RAB is set to be abolished. A new force, the SRB, will take its place.

The government has granted final approval to a draft law that will lead to the abolition of the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) and the creation of the Special Security Bureau (SRB).

This major structural change in the country's security apparatus aims to replace the elite force with a new entity.

The decision comes after a period of review and deliberation regarding the role and legal framework of the security forces.

The SRB will take over the responsibilities previously held by RAB, though specific operational details of the new bureau are still being finalized.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Saudi Crown Prince [[invites PM Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia]]
headline: Saudi Crown Prince invites PM Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia
summary: The invitation aims to strengthen bilateral ties and discuss regional and international issues between the two nations.
details: Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud has invited Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia.
The invitation was handed over by the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Dr Abdullah Zafer H bin Abiyah, during a meeting at the PM’s office in the Secretariat today.
The visit is intended to discuss ways to strengthen bilateral relations and exchange views on regional and international issues.
In the invitation letter, the Saudi crown prince expressed a keenness to further strengthen ties in areas of mutual interest to fulfill the aspirations of both countries.
The specific date and schedule for the visit will be determined through diplomatic channels at a mutually convenient time.
Mohammed bin Salman also conveyed his best wishes for Tarique Rahman’s health and the continued progress and prosperity of the people of Bangladesh.
caption:
A major diplomatic move as Saudi Arabia invites PM Tarique Rahman for an official visit to strengthen bilateral ties.

Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud has invited Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia.

The invitation was handed over by the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Dr Abdullah Zafer H bin Abiyah, during a meeting at the PM’s office in the Secretariat today.

The visit is intended to discuss ways to strengthen bilateral relations and exchange views on regional and international issues.

In the invitation letter, the Saudi crown prince expressed a keenness to further strengthen ties in areas of mutual interest to fulfill the aspirations of both countries.

The specific date and schedule for the visit will be determined through diplomatic channels at a mutually convenient time.

Mohammed bin Salman also conveyed his best wishes for Tarique Rahman’s health and the continued progress and prosperity of the people of Bangladesh.
